welcome.headline: WELCOME BACK.
welcome.body: You can rebuild your body, confidence, discipline and lifestyle.
welcome.support: Become the version of yourself you're proud of.

how.title: HOW IT WORKS
how.subtitle: Define your Prime. Build your plan. Complete your missions. Track your comeback.

s1.title: Define who you want to become
s1.body: Choose the goals that matter to you, or write your own.

s2.title: Build your comeback plan
s2.body: A realistic plan that fits the time you really have.

s3.title: Take action every day
s3.body: Complete missions, grow your streak and watch your progress.

goals.title: WHAT DOES YOUR PRIME LOOK LIKE?
goals.subtitle: Choose everything that matters to you. You can change this anytime.
goals.minOne: Choose at least one goal to continue.
goals.max: That's {{count}} goals, a strong plan. You can add more later.
goals.customArea: Which area is it part of?

memory.title: WHEN DID YOU FEEL LIKE YOUR BEST SELF?
memory.subtitle: There's no wrong answer. This helps us frame your comeback.
memory.regain: What would you like to regain?
memory.firstPrime: What would your first Prime look like?
memory.private: Your answers stay private on this device.

start.title: YOUR STARTING POINT
start.subtitle: A few quick questions so your plan fits your life. Skip anything you like.
start.privacy: We never ask for medical or financial details.
start.activity: How active are you right now?
start.training: Where do you prefer to train?
start.confidence: Where do you want to feel more confident?
start.money: What would you like to focus on?
start.sleep: How do you sleep at the moment?
start.priority: What matters most in your everyday life?

duration.title: CHOOSE YOUR COMEBACK
duration.subtitle: How long should your first program run? You can change it later.

time.title: HOW MUCH TIME DO YOU HAVE EACH DAY?
time.subtitle: Be realistic. Your daily missions will fit into this time.

avatar.title: CREATE YOUR PRIME AVATAR
avatar.subtitle: Your avatar stands at the centre of Prime Control. Choose a starting look. You can change it anytime.
avatar.hint: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom

ready.title: YOUR PRIME PLAN IS READY
ready.subtitle: Here's how your comeback begins, {{name}}.
ready.demoHint: Starts you on day {{day}} with example history so you can explore every screen.

calendar.title: PRIME CALENDAR

calendar.recoveryLimit: Up to {{count}} recovery days per week.
calendar.readOnly: History is read-only so your record stays accurate.
calendar.rules: Your Prime Streak counts consecutive days you showed up: Prime, Active or planned Recovery days. A missed day starts a new streak, but your totals and longest streak are always kept.

journey.title: PRIME JOURNEY
journey.subtitle: Your {{days}}-day comeback.

reset.name: RESET
reset.body: Build foundations, set manageable routines and understand your obstacles.

rebuild.name: REBUILD
rebuild.body: Increase consistency, develop skills and strengthen your habits.

prime.name: PRIME
prime.body: Consolidate your progress, review your achievements and prepare your next chapter.

journey.honesty: Your journey measures the actions you take. Results differ for everyone. What matters is that you keep showing up.
journey.completeBody: Review what you built, then decide what comes next.

evolution.title: PRIME EVOLUTION
evolution.subtitle: Your transformation, documented privately.
evolution.checkinBody: How do you rate yourself this week? 1 = low, 10 = great.
evolution.measurementsBody: Optional. Only track what feels useful to you.

studio.title: AVATAR STUDIO

coach.title: PRIME COACH
coach.subtitle: Guidance based on your plan and progress.
coach.previewNote: This preview uses your plan data on this device. A personal AI coach is in development and will only use your data with your permission.

messages.start: Day one is the hardest decision, and you already made it. Pick your easiest mission and finish it within the next hour.
messages.allDone: Every mission done today. Rest well: recovery is where progress settles in.
messages.someDone: You've already moved today. One more mission keeps the momentum going.
messages.noneYet: Nothing done yet today, and that's fine. Start with the shortest mission: {{minutes}} minutes.
messages.recovery: Today is a recovery day. Recharging is part of the program.
messages.afterMiss: Yesterday didn't go to plan. That doesn't erase anything. Today is a fresh start.
messages.streak: {{count}} days in a row. You're proving to yourself that you follow through.

tips.lowArea: Your {{area}} missions are at {{percent}}%. Try making them shorter or easier for a week.
tips.tooMuch: You're completing less than half of your missions. A smaller daily time could make the plan fit better.
tips.strong: You're completing most of your missions. When you're ready, add a new action to keep growing.

coach.limits: The coach doesn't give medical, nutritional or financial advice. For those questions, please talk to a qualified professional.

pro.title: PRIME PRO
pro.subtitle: Go further when you're ready. Everything you need to start is free.
pro.note: Prime Pro isn't available yet. No payments are taken in this version.
